subject: Commercial design for private deployment — platform fee + SRE retainer
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@mediscope.com>, Mediscope Procurement <procurement@mediscope.com>
Cc: Tom Brewer <t.brewer@mediscope.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment commercial — initial proposal

Hi Elena / team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I attached a concise commercial proposal for Mediscope's private VPC deployment. High-level summary below so procurement can triage quickly: 

- Platform fee: $95k/year, covers control plane, model catalog, and observability (tested at the pilot scale described).
- Node credits: pre-purchase 40 node-credits (each credit = 1 GPU-equivalent-month) at $2,400/credit; unused credits roll over for 6 months.
- SRE retainer: optional 1, 3, 5 day SLA windows — starts at $12k/month for Bronze (business-hours) up to $45k/month for Platinum (24x7).
- Migration credit: one-time $30k implementation credit if you commit to a 24-month term.

Attachments: privdeploy-pricing-proposal-v1.pdf, sow-draft-mediscp-revA.docx

Questions for procurement:
1) Is a single invoice to Mediscope OK (platform fee + node credits), or do you need separate invoices for licensing vs hosting?
2) Any procurement-specific PO/contracting constraints we should know before legal redlines (billing cadence, PO templates, escrow requirements)?

Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through. If you'd like a different anchoring (lower platform fee + higher per-node price), we can propose that as an alternate.

Best,
Kimberly Park

Kimberly —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear options. A few quick asks from our side as procurement evaluates:

- The platform fee looks high relative to our expected steady-state footprint; can you run an alternate with a lower annual platform fee (e.g., $55k) offset by higher node credit pricing so the TCO for year 1 is roughly equivalent?
- We are sensitive to multi-year lock—what flexibility exists for a 12-month starter with an option to extend at pre-negotiated rates?
- For SRE retainer: can you clarify what "Bronze business-hours" covers (response time SLA, number of incident hours included)?
- Legal: we will need an escrow / source-escrow clause (for on-prem deployments) and a limitation of liability cap aligned with our procurement policy. Can you confirm Redwood accepts a mutual cap tied to fees?

Cc'ing our procurement lead Tom — Tom, can you share any standard PO or contract language we should expect?

Thanks,
Elena

Team — forwarding Mediscope's reply. Procurement (Tom) wants a lower platform fee alternative, flexibility on term, clearer SRE scope, and confirmation on mutual MoL/escrow. I suggested we could trade platform fee vs node price and offer a 12-month pilot with an extension option, but legal will need guidance on escrow and cap language.

Can you help draft two alternate offers we can send tomorrow:
A) Lower platform fee / higher node price (target platform $55k) with 12m starter + option to 24m at pre-negotiated uplift. Include migration credit pro-rated.
B) Keep platform fee at $95k but provide steeper node credit discount and 2 months free SRE for migration.

Also, please propose concrete SRE definitions for Bronze/Gold/Platinum (response times, included hours, escalation path).

Thanks — Kim

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment commercial — initial proposal

Kim / Marissa —

Drafting two clean commercial constructs below. I focused on modular concessions that legal can accept without changing core product terms.

Option A — Starter-friendly anchor (12m pilot)
- Platform fee: $55,000/year (billed annually for pilot)
- Node credits: $2,950/credit, 40 credits recommended (year 1 run-rate); credits roll over for 3 months for pilot customers
- Migration credit: $20,000 (applied to first invoice)
- Extension option: 12m extension at a 7% uplift on node credits if exercised within 90 days of pilot end
- SLA/SRE: Bronze = business-hours response (8x5) 8-hour response, up to 10 incident-hours/month; Gold = 4-hour response, 20 incident-hours/month; Platinum = 1-hour response, on-call + 24x7 coverage
- Legal/escrow: propose mutual limitation of liability capped at the greater of $250k or 6 months of paid fees; escrow clause limited to binary artifacts used for deployment (no daily sync).

Option B — Full commercial (2-year preferred)
- Platform fee: $95,000/year (billed annually)
- Node credits: $2,200/credit, 48 credits recommended (year 1 committed)
- Migration credit: $30,000 + 60 days free SRE (Gold) during cutover
- Term: 24 months preferred; 12-month with 10% premium on node pricing
- SLA/SRE: same tiers; if they commit to Platinum retainer for year 1 we include 3x on-call holidays per year without extra charge
- Legal/escrow: accept mutual cap equal to 6 months of fees; escrow deposit triggered only on enterprise production go-live; Redwood retains right to remove proprietary training-time optimizations from escrow.

Notes on trade-offs: lowering platform fee means we need to preserve margin on nodes (higher credit price) and shorten credit rollover. If they push a strict mutual cap tied to contract value, we can accept 6 months fees but not a full revenue-based cap beyond that.

Attachments I'm preparing: 1) alt-pricing-grid.xlsx, 2) SRE-term-sheet.docx — I'll share shortly.

If Marissa agrees with language, Kimberly you can send Option A as the starter and include Option B as the preferred path. I'll copy legal with redline guidance once Mediscope signals preferred option.

— Logan Wright
Pricing & Packaging | Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com

Elena / Tom —

Thanks for the clear feedback. Attached is a short, actionable proposal with two paths so procurement can pick the one that maps to your risk appetite: Starter-friendly (12m pilot) and Preferred (2-year anchored). Highlights:

Starter-friendly (Option A):
- Platform fee: $55k/year (pilot), node credits $2,950/credit, migration credit $20k, 12m term with an option to extend at a defined uplift.
- Bronze SRE (8x5) includes 8-hour response and up to 10 incident-hours/month.

Preferred (Option B):
- Platform fee: $95k/year, node credits $2,200/credit, migration credit $30k + Gold SRE during migration for 60 days. 24m term preferred.

Legal: we can accept a mutual limitation of liability capped at the greater of $250k or 6 months of fees and will include a narrowly scoped escrow for deployment artifacts only. I copied Logan for any final tweaks to the SRE definition and Marissa for implementation scoping.

Next steps:
1) If you want Option A, confirm and we'll issue an updated quote and a 12m SOW.
2) If you want Option B, confirm commitment term and we'll move to commercial redlines + DocuSign.
3) If procurement needs additional PO templates or specific escrow language, ask Tom to share and we'll loop legal.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call tomorrow to close?

Best regards,
Kim
